content: Detector gap: stranded-skill detection covers SKILL.md only - extend check-skill-drift-parity.py to SUPPORT files under repo-owned skill dirs. Measured 2026-10-15 by the orch-bus-worker pass: 131 deployed-only files across 386 repo-owned skill dirs (e.g. devops/enforcement-gate-migration/references+//templates, devops/auto-remediation/references/, devops/loop-governance/references/, software-development/change-checklist/references/). The deploy guardrail refuses to overwrite deployed copies, so these never reach the fleet. Fix direction: walk references/, templates/, scripts/ under repo-owned skill dirs with the same content-not-mtime direction rule, then decide the 131 by content (many may be deliberately repo-ahead). Evidence: docs/evidence/stranded-skills-reconcile-2026-10-15.txt (cycle 12652).
